notes:
Account snapshot:
- Heliotrope runs a multitenant contact platform + managed services for finance and healthcare clients. 3x growth in inbound for last 12 months.
- They operate strict retention and air-gapped deployments for some regulated customers.

Primary goals:
- Replace current post-call summarization pipeline (slow, inconsistent). Need structured summary + QA flags + coaching highlights per call. Summaries must be concise (20-40 words) and capture compliance lines verbatim when present.
- Real-time agent-assist features: live hints, policy reminders, and one-click tool-calls (CRMs, payment portal). Latency p95 target for assist < 300ms.
- Reliability at peak: design to withstand 600 calls/min sustained for 30m during marketing/utility outage scenarios without queueing or failed callbacks.
- Cost objective: 35% cost reduction vs incumbent per-call inference while improving supervisor throughput.

Technical integration notes:
- Current flow: media -> vendor ASR -> event bus (Kafka) -> enrichment layer -> ticketing. They want Redwood to accept ASR + call metadata and return: {summary, qa_tags, confidence_scores, suggested_actions}.
- Must support idempotent webhooks, backpressure signals, and replay from offsets. TLS mTLS required for callbacks to on-prem webhooks.
- Need regionally pinned model routing (EU data residency for EU-origin calls).

POC / Demo plan:
- Multi-day demo followed by 2-week POC. Demo scope: batch-run 10k historical calls through Redwood Optimize pipeline, live demo of streaming assist on 20 agents.
- POC goals: validate latency, QA false-positive rate (<1%), action accuracy for tool-calling, and sustained throughput under synthetic spikes.
- Success criteria: supervisors report >=30% time saved in triage tasks; no security exceptions; performance SLOs met for 48h spike.

Security and compliance:
- Must pass external security questionnaire and provide deployment options that keep call audio & transcripts in customer-controlled storage.
- KMS integration required; HSM preferred for certain customers.
- "If we can't supply an air-gapped option for some clients, we cannot move forward," noted Head of Security on 2026-02-04.

Commercial / stakeholders:
- Champion: VP of Product Ops. Executive sponsor: COO. Procurement lead involved early; wants fixed-cost SOW for on-prem bundle.
- Legal flagged indemnity and data residency clauses; onboarding timeline tied to legal windows.
